title: Chapter 26
text:
[Basic Weaponry] included basic firearms and cold weapons manufacturing knowledge. It reduced the number of times required to master basic firearms blueprints and increased the efficiency of weapon manufacturing.

[Basic Materials Encyclopedia] was the core knowledge of the Weaponry branch. The basic attributes of mechanical equipment were determined by the raw materials used. The new generation of raw materials could even revolutionize the technology and improve the overall quality of mechanical equipment. Many synthetic materials were prerequisites for high-level machinery.

You have learned five basic knowledge of the Weaponry branch. You have learned the skills [Basic Refining] and [Overload]!

You have learned the blueprint [Robot – Ranger]!

[Basic Refining] allowed him to refine materials and increase the grade of materials. Skills with the word 'Basic' or 'Simple' were usually the basic core skills of a class. After reaching the Advanced level, [Molecular Refining] could directly change the properties of materials.

Materials were also graded like equipment. The higher the quality, the higher the value. Even materials of the same quality had different grades. For example, a common raw material, Iron Rock, cost 13 Aquamarine per pound, while Iron Rock, which was refined into Iron Rock, cost 45 Aquamarine per pound.

Materials also had their own characteristics. For example, metals that were suitable for energy transmission were not suitable for making armor.

[Overload]: Active skill. Consumes energy. Increases the power of machinery by 30-50% for a short period of time. Greatly reduces durability. For example, the Lightweight Mechanical Arm that Han Xiao had once used. Once Overload was used, its attack and defense would increase by 30-50%. With his 120 energy points, he could only use it for about ten seconds.

Finally, I've learned an active skill! Han Xiao was excited. There were very few active skills in the early stages of the Mechanic class. If only he had one when he was escaping from the Germinal Organization, he would not have had such a hard time escaping.

[Robot – Ranger] was one of the easiest blueprints to obtain in the early stages. It was a low-tech multi-purpose robot that could be equipped with various equipment and machinery. It could be used for combat, exploration, defense, support, and even self-destruct. A high level of versatility meant that there were not many key points. Han Xiao knew that the logistics teams of many guilds used the support type of Ranger for exploration and mining.

Some of the blueprints for Mechanics had already existed, while others had not. The situation was different on every planet.

Two Potential Points for so many skills! What a bargain!

Old Man Lu walked over and asked curiously, "You've been so excited since the beginning. What are you doing?"

Han Xiao glanced at Old Man Lu and said, "Don't you think it's weird for you to be strolling around here?"

"Disharmony? Why? " Old Man Lu lowered his head and looked at his beach shorts. He shook the bottle of wine in his hand and burped. He didn't think there was anything wrong with it at all.

Lu Qian put down the welding torch in her hand. Her face was flushed with sweat from the heat wave. She rolled her eyes through her protective glasses and said in a stiff tone, "It's working hours. Irrelevant people, please leave as far as possible."

"Stinky girl." Old Man Lu mumbled to himself as he downed a mouthful of wine. Then, he leisurely went out for a stroll.

"Boss, do we fix things here?"

As soon as Old Man Lu left, a middle-aged man came in.

Han Xiao looked over and found that the middle-aged man was also looking at him. When their eyes met, the middle-aged man looked away.

Han Xiao was slightly startled. He immediately lowered his gaze and noticed that the middle-aged man's footsteps were steady and powerful. He immediately understood something, but his expression did not change.

There was an 80% chance that this person was an intelligence agent from Division 13 sent to test him.

Lu Qian walked up to him with a polite smile on her face. "Hello, may I ask what you want to fix?"

"My car broke down. It's at the intersection." The middle-aged man looked past Lu Qian and observed Han Xiao.

"Okay, no problem." Lu Qian was about to leave with her toolbox when the middle-aged man suddenly pointed at Han Xiao and said, "I want that little brother to help me fix my car."

Lu Qian was stunned and a little depressed. Do I look bad? You're discriminating against women!

"I'll do it." Han Xiao took the toolbox from Lu Qian, who was full of resentment.

The two walked out of the alley and saw an old car parked at the side of the road.

"This is the car."

Han Xiao opened the hood of the car, took a look, and took out the repair tools from the toolbox to start the repair.

The middle-aged man leaned against the car and pretended to be looking for a topic. "Young man, you're not that old, right?"

"I'm thirty."

Thirty? Do you think I'm blind? The middle-aged man almost choked. The corner of his mouth twitched. "Little brother, how should I address you?"

Han Xiao didn't even raise his head. "Before you ask for someone's name, you have to show your sincerity."

The middle-aged man had to say, "My name is Feng Jun."

"Good name." Han Xiao's tone was calm. There was no hint of praise.

Feng Jun was annoyed. Why did he sound like he was praising "Laifu" or "Wangcai"? Besides, what was so good about his name?

"But you misunderstood me." Han Xiao rolled his eyes. "I just want a cigarette."

Feng Jun's face was very stiff. He lit a cigarette for Han Xiao.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and buried his head in repairing the car. "You can call me Han Xiao."

Feng Jun secretly remembered it and continued to probe. "Han Xiao, you're not from West City, right? Where are you from …"

"It's fixed."

Feng Jun's prepared words were swallowed in his stomach. His expression was constipated.

What the hell? My probing has only just begun! Do you have to be so good with your skills?!

Han Xiao stretched out his hand with a blank face. "The hydraulic pipe is broken. I'll give you 60. Pay up."

Of course I know it's the hydraulic pipe. I did it myself!

Feng Jun took out his wallet and took out the money as slowly as possible. It was as if his wallet was a bottomless pit. He wanted to delay and ask a few more questions. "Your skills are really good. Where did you learn it?"

"Self-taught."

"Oh, that's amazing. Where are you from?"

"Country bumpkin."

"… …"

Han Xiao saw Feng Jun taking out the money for a long time and raised his eyebrows. "Are you reminding me to give you a discount?"

Feng Jun coughed and finally took out the money and handed it to Han Xiao. What else could he do? He couldn't just not pay. He didn't know if the organization would reimburse him.

Han Xiao laughed. "This is the first time I've seen such an unfathomable wallet. I thought you would take half an hour."

Feng Jun dared to swear to God that if he didn't have to complete the mission, he would lose if he stayed one more second.

Han Xiao whistled, picked up the toolbox, and walked back the way he came.

Feng Jun made a phone call with a depressed face. "Preliminary observation result. The target is a mechanic. Unable to estimate the danger level for the time being. The conversation took four minutes and thirty-eight seconds. We only know that the target calls himself Han Xiao. It is recommended to further probe and investigate. Do not have any conflicts with him."

"Analysis of the target's personality? Hmm … very bad! "
